Southern California Faces Fire Risk Amid Santa Ana Winds

Southern California is facing an emerging fire risk, particularly in Malibu, with evacuation orders issued due to a wildfire. The region is also under wildfire warnings, exacerbated by Santa Ana winds. Separately, California has ordered lenders to report on their handling of insurance payouts to survivors of Los Angeles fires.
